title: The generalized-low proof repeats the halting test instead of testing divergence.
details: Marks2024-02-25, Lemma20.5 proof, p80, visually checked. Its final sentence tests whether the prefix forces halting twice. The second alternative must be that no extension of the prefix has a successful finite halting computation, so the prefix forces divergence. The first property is a finite certificate test and the second is a co-c.e. extension property decidable with the halting oracle. For a1-generic one alternative eventually occurs along its prefixes; the resulting decision computes its jump from its join with the halting set. The theorem statement is unchanged.
